title: fix(update): preserve original authority during recovery admission
body:
Related: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/143752

## Problem

Interrupted package recovery must reacquire its recorded original authority. It must refuse an authority store that is missing, replaced, linked, or still owned by a live process instead of recreating that store or bypassing its owner.

## Changes

- Preserve read-only original-domain admission and existing SQLite ownership checks, including the retained Bun snapshot-lock handling.
- Capture executor authority before update work, preserve pending-recovery refusal before writable preparation, and retain strict retired-record filtering.
- Reconcile with landed #144313 and main's service-environment owner.
- Retain the reviewed journal BLOB byte bounds and service-plan extraction. Preserve complete test-shard ownership without raising limits.

Vincent Koc's original authority-admission head is retained as the first merge parent. Jason Sy's integration fixes are source-reviewed separately. Layer 2 of eight; #144313 is merged at `7905e684051c206847d649093e077455a87549c0`. Later layers remain separate.

## Evidence

- Signed published head: `d085b8f78bfeccd5bc47208445842a47e749f42b`.
- Exact candidate tree: `df3afed5ccd17b2c77ed0ad4e265dd876241a772` on landed main `7905e684051c206847d649093e077455a87549c0`.
- Completed independent changed-base source review found no actionable P0/P1/P2 issue. Nineteen of twenty layer files are byte-identical to the previously reviewed repair; the additional mainline shard exclusion retains coverage.
- Owner execution on this exact candidate: **21 integration tests passed**, covering pending admission and strict retired-record behavior; **30-stage changed-code gate passed**, including types, export scans, lint, storage and runtime guards.
- Prior exact-head and repair results remain separately source-bound. They do not qualify this candidate by transfer. The independent reviewers ran no tests.
- Successful hosted CI on the exact published head remains required before merge. Draft-skipped runs and predecessor checks do not count.

## Hosted component execution

Normal PR CI [run 34561283343](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/34561283343), attempt 1, is bound to head `d085b8f78bfeccd5bc47208445842a47e749f42b`. Its jobs checked out GitHub merge commit `c52e15538987c105c047940f5f122a1bd503c503` (base `7f8a694ee1c862db91b056f0c950ca03b20effb1` plus this head). All 174 reviewed source/dependency/config bindings, including all 20 layer paths, are byte-identical between the head and that tested merge. This is normal PR merge-checkout qualification, not a claim that a branch-only run was performed.

| Completed job / file | Executed result | Observed behavior |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [CLI job](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/34561283343/job/103144473858), `update-command-executor.test.ts` | 20 passed, none skipped | Fresh acquisition, exclusivity across await, exact release; recovery obtains a new owner without reviving the old fence; revoked real child refuses before writing its output; mismatched parent generation refuses; surviving descendant and dead-parent/live-child cases retain exclusion until the child exits. |
| Same CLI job, `update-command-pending-recovery.test.ts` | 19 passed | Pending admission refuses before writable preparation; displaced canonical authority stays missing; retained material and terminal unwind stay untouched. |
| [Infra job](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/34561283343/job/103144473361), `update-managed-service-handoff-database.test.ts` | 44 passed, 1 Bun-only case skipped | Existing-store admission and release preserve missing/replaced/corrupt/linked authority without repair; same-inode database under a replacement parent refuses; replacements after open, after begin and before commit refuse; independent real SQLite writers remain excluded across nested reads and until child settlement plus release commit. |
| Same infra job, cross-process / retired-record files | 14 passed + 1 Windows-only skip / 2 passed | Helper-process ownership and surviving updater exclusion; exact retired-v1 filtering with unknown refusal and retained v3 custody. |

These are existing tests collected from completed hosted job logs, not reruns. The full CLI shard passed 7,977 tests with 51 skips; the relevant infra group passed 1,982 with 5 skips. The file-level results above identify which controls actually ran. Bun snapshot runtime qualification is **not** claimed from the skipped Bun-only case. The final aggregate CI gate remains required before merge.

### Admission compatibility

The same hosted executor controls exercise both an initially empty private coordination directory (fresh store acquisition and release) and recovery from an existing captured authority: a fresh owner is acquired, the old owner/fence remains revoked, the admitted installation key is retained even when the package root is absent, and no missing canonical authority is recreated. These are component-level fresh/existing-authority compatibility controls using the production lease/database/process-start owners, not an installed package upgrade run.

The reconciliation adds no schema migration. Known retired-v1 interpretation and v3 custody are retained; unknown input refuses. Full installed upgrade/recovery, native movement and later F2 proof remain separate and are not waived by these component results.

## Compatibility and limits

This reconciliation does not add a replacement authority, a new recovery domain, or a new storage migration. Existing strict retired-record interpretation and custody checks remain in place; unknown payloads still refuse. The layer's authority and journal mechanisms are scoped to interrupted-update admission, not a claim that the full recovery lifecycle is qualified.

Native movement, complete recovery/F2, and installed-upgrade proof remain owned by the later work. This PR does not release installed HOLD or qualify those paths.
